To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• Many e-commerce websites suffer from the continuous cold start problem, where recommender systems fail to recommend items to known users or items due to lack of information.

(a) the cold-start problem in e-commerce recommender systems is aggravated by the fact that users change their interests over the time and exhibit different personas, and (b) the continuous cold-start problem can be solved by using a combination of techniques such as collaborative filtering, content-based filtering, context-based filtering, and social filtering.
the continuous cold-start problem (CoCoS), a recurring version of the well-known cold-start problem, is a major issue for e-commerce applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
recommender systems for e-commerce websites.
the following question: how do we build a recommender system that is able to handle the CoCoS problem?
the following questions: (i) what is the nature of the continuous cold-start problem, and (ii) how does the continuous cold-start affect the performance of recommender systems?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
recommender systems are a very useful tool for e-commerce sites, but they are not a panacea for all the ills of the industry.
recommender systems are a very important part of the online shopping experience.
the cold start problem is a real and important problem for recommender systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have exposed the continuous cold start problem in e-commerce recommender systems and proposed a number of solutions.
we have exposed the `Continuous Cold-start' (CoCoSo problem and its consequences in the context of typical e-commerce application.
we are able to provide the first comprehensive overview and analysis of the CoCoS problem in e-commerce applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cold-start problem is not a one-time problem that can be solved by a one-off effort.
recommender systems should be aware of the fact that user preferences change over time and that they need to take into account that users have different personas.
the cold-start problem is not just a problem of the recommender system, but a problem of the entire e-commerce website, and it can be solved by a holistic approach.
